privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: What a hotel and le-hoetel keep about you, why, and how to take it back.

collect.title: What is collected
collect.body: Your name, phone number and language, because the hotel needs them to welcome you. Your birthday and email only if you add them. Nothing else without a clear yes: never your location, ID or passport number, or payment card.

use.title: Why
use.body: So the hotel can welcome you, send a birthday wish, ask how your stay went, and answer you if something was wrong.

consent.title: Messages and your yes
consent.body: Offers and news come by WhatsApp or email only if you switched that channel on. We record when, where and with which wording you said yes. Every message has a link to stop, and replying STOP on WhatsApp works too.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Ask the hotel for a copy of your data or for its deletion at any time. Deletion is complete. You can also take your yes back with the link in any message. Tunisian law on personal data protection applies (Organic Law 2004-63).

keep.title: Who sees it and for how long
keep.body: Only the staff of the hotel you signed up at. Hotels never see each other's guests. Data is kept while the hotel uses le-hoetel and is deleted when you ask or when the hotel leaves.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: The simple rules for hotels using le-hoetel.

service.title: The service
service.body: le-hoetel helps a hotel collect guests with their consent, send messages they agreed to, and hear from unhappy guests early. It is in pilot: features and prices can change.

duties.title: What a hotel promises
duties.body: To collect only guests who said yes, to honour every stop request, never to send spam, and to answer export and delete requests.

pilot.title: Pilot and price
pilot.body: The pilot is free for 60 to 90 days. Nothing is charged without a written agreement. Prices shown during the pilot are not final.

data.title: Your data
data.body: The hotel owns its guest list and can export or delete it at any time. We do not sell or share it.

end.title: Ending
end.body: Either side can stop at any time. When it ends the hotel can take its data and we delete the rest.

meta.title: le-hoetel: hear about unhappy guests first, own your guest list
meta.description: Guests join by QR code, you keep the contacts, and a low score reaches you the same day. More Google reviews, more guests coming back direct. Free pilot for hotels in Tunisia.

hero.title: Hear about an unhappy guest before they write the review.
hero.subtitle: Guests join with a QR code, you keep the contact list, and a low score reaches you the same day. More Google reviews, more guests coming back direct.
hero.note: Free pilot for 60 to 90 days. No app for your guests.

alerts.title: Unhappy guests reach you first
alerts.body: A low score alerts the manager within a day, so a problem is fixed before it becomes a review.

reviews.title: More Google reviews
reviews.body: Happy guests get a link to review you on Google. Unhappy ones talk to you instead.

list.title: A guest list you own
list.body: Name, phone and consent in your hands, not in the hands of a booking site.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Three steps, and the first one takes a guest ten seconds.

qr.title: A QR code in every room
qr.body: Guests scan it in the room, at the table or at the desk. Name, phone, language and a clear yes, in French, Arabic or English.

messages.title: Warm messages, only with consent
messages.body: A welcome, a thank-you after the stay, a birthday wish. On WhatsApp or email, only the channel the guest chose, with a way to stop every time.

feedback.title: Feedback that finds you
feedback.body: One question after the stay. Happy guests are invited to Google. A low score lands on the manager's phone with the guest's contact.

preview.title: What happened this week, on one screen
preview.subtitle: Who joined, who is unhappy, what to do next.
preview.label: A sample of the hotel dashboard with made-up numbers
preview.alertBody: Room 204 scored 2 out of 5: "The air conditioning did not work."

pricing.title: Free to start, simple to continue
pricing.subtitle: Pilot pricing: prices are our best guess and we set the final ones with the first hotels.
pricing.freeBody: You pay only if you see results. Setup is free for the first hotels.

growth.name: Growth
growth.f2: Campaigns and offers with a redemption QR

pricing.note: WhatsApp messages are billed at cost plus a small margin from a prepaid balance, so there are no surprise bills.

trust.title: Your guests' data, handled properly
trust.subtitle: Built for the Tunisian law on personal data from the first line.

consent.title: Consent per channel
consent.body: WhatsApp and email are separate choices, both off by default. Every yes is logged with the date and the exact wording.

stop.title: A stop link in every message
stop.body: A guest leaves in one tap, and replying STOP on WhatsApp works too.

control.title: Export or delete, any time
control.body: One guest or the whole hotel, in one click.

apart.title: Hotels never see each other's guests
apart.body: Every hotel's data is kept apart.

minimum.title: Only what is needed
minimum.body: Name, phone and language. Birthday and email only if the guest adds them. Never location, ID numbers or payment cards.

guest.q: What does my guest actually do?
guest.a: Scans the QR code, types a name and a phone number, and chooses what they agree to receive. No app and no account.

setup.q: How long does it take to start?
setup.a: A day. You send your logo and two colors, we give you QR codes to print for rooms, tables and the desk.

whatsapp.q: Can I message guests on WhatsApp?
whatsapp.a: Yes, only guests who said yes to WhatsApp, and every message gives them a way to stop.

price.q: How much does it cost after the pilot?
price.a: Plans start at 99 TND a month. The pilot is free for 60 to 90 days and nothing is charged without a written agreement.

leave.q: What if a guest asks me to delete their data?
leave.a: One click exports or deletes that guest and everything linked to them.

own.a: You do. You can export it at any time, and we never sell or share it.
